ruling: Lifecraft Engine's 'Vehicle creatures you control are the chosen creature type' is a layer-4 type-adding effect that depends (CR 613.8a) on the Crew effect that makes the Vehicle an artifact creature: the crew effect applies first, so the crewed Vehicle is a creature when the chosen-type effect is applied and gains the chosen type. gorge orders the two by that dependency; XMage orders them by timestamp (the static's is older than the crew effect's), so the crewed Vehicle never gains the chosen type. XMage's layer-ordering artifact, not a gorge defect.
